description: Verify that TCP ignores an incoming segment with RST flag in LISTEN state (RFC 793 §3.9 p65)
approach:
[Objective]
A RST in LISTEN has no connection to abort. Like CLOSING_13 (CLOSED), DUT must silently drop. Verified by sending a fresh SYN afterward and seeing the LISTEN socket still answer.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN+RST (or bare RST in LISTEN).
3. Observation: DUT must NOT respond.
4. Tester → DUT: fresh SYN → DUT must reply SYN,ACK (LISTEN survived).

[Pass condition]
No DUT response to SYN+RST AND LISTEN socket still answers fresh SYN.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_first_synack — first SYN did not get SYN,ACK (prelude broken)
• Fail_unexpected_response_to_syn_rst — DUT responded to SYN+RST
• Fail_p3_no_synack — LISTEN socket did not survive

verdicts.Fail_timeout_first_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK to first tester SYN
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_response_to_syn_rst: DUT emitted response after SYN+RST in LISTEN
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_synack: LISTEN socket did not survive SYN+RST
